guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: The metrics show recommendationservice latency and CPU spiking by over 650% with z-scores exceeding 67, far outpacing all other services. The retrieved runbook confirms this symptom corresponds to conntrack limits being reached, which causes socket exhaustion and dropped connections.

proposed_fix.description: Increase the system conntrack limit or patch the connection leak in recommendationservice to prevent socket exhaustion.
